oceanario.title: OCEANÁRIO DE LISBOA
oceanario.meta_title: Oceanário de Lisboa merchandising — case study | Vinco Studio
oceanario.meta_description: Oceanário de Lisboa case study — end-to-end merchandising with around 800 products since 2021.
oceanario.description: Since 2021, we develop and manage the merchandising offering for Oceanário de Lisboa’s store. A portfolio of approximately 800 products, distributed across multiple categories: from stationery, textiles, souvenirs to gifting. A long-term project that demands both creative vision and operational rigour: from product conception to lifecycle management of each item, with a commitment to sustainable practices. Since the beginning, Vinco has contributed to continuous business growth - which in 2025 exceeded 2 million euros in annual sales.

foa.title: FUNDAÇÃO OCEANO AZUL
foa.meta_title: Fundação Oceano Azul uniform — case study | Vinco Studio
foa.meta_description: Fundação Oceano Azul case study — unisex institutional uniform from concept to production.
foa.description: Design and production of a unisex, multipurpose uniform developed to support the Foundation's diverse contexts—from UN international commissions and conferences including the United Nations Ocean Conference, to maritime missions and expeditions such as Gorringe. Vinco managed the end-to-end process as the sole intermediary between design teams, suppliers and logistics partners, preventing information loss, ensuring quality control and responsive delivery, with results meeting expectations and strict timelines.

about.title: About
about.intro:
Vinco is an end-to-end product development studio.
We work with brands, institutions and creatives to take concepts from strategic definition through to production and final communication.
about.meta_description: Meet Vinco Studio — end-to-end product development for brands, institutions and creators.
about.studio_body:
We believe every object should be designed with intention: from form to materials, from process to the way it reaches the world.

Our work spans diverse categories including apparel, accessories, stationery and institutional merchandising. We oversee each project stage, maintaining control across all phases: strategic definition, formal development, material selection, sourcing, production management and brand communication.

The result is a fully coordinated project: each product reflects your vision, while we manage all operational complexities, allowing you to focus exclusively on what matters.
about.founder_bio:
She started in communication, but fashion defined her path. After graduating in Social Communication from Universidade Católica, she moved to Paris, where she completed a Master's in Fashion Marketing & Management at ISEM. For ten years she worked at international reference brands including Joseph and Yves Saint Laurent, where she learned that rigour, detail and coherence between concept and execution are fundamental.

In 2019, she joined Burberry in London before returning to Portugal in 2021, where she began providing independent consulting in product development.

In 2026, she formalized this practice with the creation of Vinco Studio - to transform ideas into products that work, with method, clarity and intention.
